about: Voice and sound for the demo video, in English. Narrator: Roger (laid-back, conversational), eleven_multilingual_v2, low stability so it sounds spoken, not read. Mix the voice slightly under the scene's ambience. Generate with tools/elevenlabs_audio.py.

clips.name: n01-hook
clips.text: So, it's Christmas Eve... and the map says Kahvila Aurora's open till six. ... Yeah. The door doesn't agree.

clips.name: n11-title
clips.text: Connect suggests. ... The owner decides.

clips.name: sfx01-snow-door
clips.text: Quiet winter street at night: slow footsteps crunching on fresh snow, stopping, then a locked wooden shop door handle pulled and rattled twice, a soft disappointed exhale, distant muffled city hum

clips.name: sfx02-cafe-busy
clips.text: Busy small cafe behind the counter: espresso machine hiss, cups clattering, murmur of customers

clips.name: sfx03-message
clips.text: Soft, pleasant smartphone message notification, two gentle notes

clips.name: sfx04-cafe-open
clips.text: Warm cozy cafe on a winter evening: a small door bell chimes as the door opens, cheerful murmur, cups clinking, soft laughter

clips.name: sfx05-tone
clips.text: Single soft warm ambient synth tone, gentle swell, calm and confident, for an end title

clips.name: f21-aleksi
clips.text: Aleksi always closes early on Christmas Eve. He just never gets round to changing it online. ... This year, Connect noticed for him.

clips.name: f22-tap
clips.text: One short message. One tap, and it's sorted. No login, no hassle.

clips.name: f23-updated
clips.text: Updated everywhere people look... and he's back to his customers.

clips.name: f31-summer
clips.text: Now, summer. The hottest evening of the year... and a concert in the park, just down the road.

clips.name: f32-sanna
clips.text: Sanna usually closes at ten. Connect thinks tonight's worth more.

clips.name: f33-yes
clips.text: Stay open till midnight? ... Yes.

clips.name: f41-doors
clips.text: Christmas Eve... or the hottest night of summer...

clips.name: f42-open
clips.text: ...the doors are open when people come.

clips.name: p51-idea
clips.text: That's the idea. Here's what's already working.

clips.name: p52-detect
clips.text: Connect watches every listing: last year's hours, reviews, calls, similar businesses, shopping centres and local events.

clips.name: p53-suggest
clips.text: It only states a suggestion when it's confident. Otherwise it asks... or stays quiet.

clips.name: p54-message
clips.text: One message, in the owner's language. Approve, edit or decline. No login.

clips.name: p55-apply
clips.text: Approved changes go to Yext, get checked, and the owner's told where they're live.

clips.name: p56-learn
clips.text: Every answer teaches it. Owners can even hand over holidays completely... with one-tap undo.

clips.name: p57-value
clips.text: Tested on the challenge data, it protects three quarters of the searches at risk. And the same loop works for reviews and posts next.

clips.name: sfx06-summer-park
clips.text: Hot summer afternoon in a seaside park: seagulls, gentle waves, relaxed chatter of people on the grass, a distant band doing a sound check with a few drum hits

clips.name: sfx07-terrace
clips.text: Sunny seaside restaurant terrace: glasses clinking, cutlery, relaxed chatter, light breeze, distant seagulls

clips.name: sfx08-tap
clips.text: A single soft, satisfying smartphone button tap with a gentle confirmation click

clips.name: sfx09-music-bed
clips.text: Calm, warm, modern ambient piano and soft pads, gentle and optimistic corporate background music, no drums, loopable
